conversation.text: I need to make a change to my Comfort Club membership.
Is there anything else I can help you with?

I've passed this to our team: Ticket #1. Someone will contact you within one business day. You can keep asking me other questions here.

I can't make the change myself in this chat, and the facts I have don't say whether an upgrade can be processed today.
According to membership/comfort_club_overview.md (Upgrades), Standard members may upgrade to Plus at any time, and the $80 difference is prorated for the months remaining in the current term.
The facts don't give the exact prorated amount for your account, because that depends on how many months remain in your term, which I don't have.
I've added that to Ticket #1; our team will contact you within one business day.
